parts.html: The K-11 standard model is a contemporary solution for interiors where an expressive stone texture is combined with a restrained gray palette and clean furniture geometry. The straight layout, laminated fronts, and functional hardware create a practical kitchen space with a distinctive character.

The model’s main feature is its stone-effect decorative finish. It gives the kitchen the expressiveness of natural textures while preserving the visual unity of the furniture. Gray tones pair harmoniously with light walls, wooden elements, metal details, and modern flooring.

The straight layout places the main work zones along one wall. This solution suits apartments, condos, and open-plan kitchen and living areas where it is important to keep the space open and provide easy access to appliances.

The upper fronts are made of laminated MDF, and the lower ones of laminated chipboard. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard. The chipboard-based countertop completes the composition and provides a work surface for everyday cooking.

Special attention has been paid to functional equipment. FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanisms provide easy access to the contents of the upper cabinets. Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms let the doors close smoothly, and concealed Muller Profi Line runners complete the drawer system.
The kitchen includes a cargo pull-out for convenient storage of food and kitchen utensils. The model is designed for built-in appliances and does not include a separate island.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-11 model can be adapted to the individual dimensions of your room, the location of utility lines and built-in appliances, and your storage requirements. When developing the design, we take into account the specifics of the layout, the required cabinet dimensions, and the client’s material preferences.
We offer a full range of services: kitchen furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
To order the K-11 kitchen or get a personalized price quote, contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
